pages.pricingText: Plans and UZS prices will be published when learning content and verified payment providers are ready. There is nothing to purchase in this release.
pages.placementText: A placement assessment will help suggest a starting point. It is not an official CEFR certification.
pages.aboutText: Noldan Ravon is being built for learners in Uzbekistan, with Uzbek explanations and practical English learning paths.
pages.blogText: Learning guides and product updates will appear here after editorial review.
pages.contactText: Support contact details will be published before the public launch. No contact form is active in this release.
pages.faqA1: Yes. Published self-study foundation lessons are available to browse without purchase.
pages.faqA2: No. Free self-study is available; payments and enrollment have not been enabled.
pages.faqA3: No. Lesson practice scores are only self-check exercises and are not IELTS bands, official CEFR results or recognised certificates.
pages.privacyText: This development release stores the account name, email, password hash, session records, preferences, terms acceptance and security audit records in the configured database. Passwords are not stored as plain text. AI, payments, analytics vendors and microphone uploads are not active. Only the language preference is stored in browser local storage. Operator contact details, retention periods, deletion procedures and a reviewed production policy must be finalized before public launch. Do not use real student data in a development environment.
pages.termsText: This is a self-study foundation edition. Lessons provide practice and example responses, not official exam results. No paid subscriptions are enabled and no score or certification is guaranteed.
